verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Stark Bank's transaction or statement objects: no counterparty fields, rail-specific metadata, stable transaction identifiers, or enrichment of the bank feed. Related features (VerifiedAccounts, DictKeys, PaymentPreviews, BoletoHolmes, and marketing about automated reconciliation) are adjacent capabilities, not evidence of rich transaction data. The axis clearly applies to a banking API, so absent evidence the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, transaction data is rich enough to build on — counterparty details, rail-specific metadata, stable identifiers, and enrichment that makes a raw bank feed usable in-product
